process.title: From idea to
process.hint: Hover over each step to understand the process

steps.title: Your Idea
steps.detail: Everything starts with you. Tell us what you need — a system, an app or an automation. It doesn't have to be 100% defined; we're here to help organise it.

steps.title: Objective
steps.detail: Our team dives deep into your business to understand exactly what needs to be achieved. We map goals, deadlines and priorities together, with no tech jargon.

steps.title: Requirements
steps.detail: We map out every feature the product needs. You actively participate and approve the full list before we move forward.

steps.title: Approval
steps.detail: We present a clear document with everything that will be built. Your approval is the green light — nothing moves forward without your ok.

steps.title: Prototype
steps.detail: We create visual prototypes of the product — real screens you can navigate. Adjust freely before a single line of code is written.

steps.title: Structure
steps.detail: Our technical team defines how the product will be built internally to be fast, secure and ready to grow alongside your business.

steps.title: Dev
steps.detail: The development team gets to work. You follow progress with weekly deliveries and can give feedback in real time.

steps.title: Testing
steps.detail: Before delivery, we test everything exhaustively. No critical bug reaches you or your clients. Quality guaranteed.

steps.title: Launch
steps.detail: We launch, train your team and stay by your side with ongoing support and evolution. The beginning of a long partnership.
